findings.title: `.small-action-desc` no longer fills the row, so the floated edit/delete buttons lose their right alignment
findings.description: `.small-action` is now a flex container (lines 264-265), which makes `.small-action-desc` a flex item with the default `flex: 0 1 auto`. It shrinks to its content instead of filling the 755px row set in `desktop/topic-post.scss:731`. The edit/delete buttons in `templates/components/small-action.hbs:4-9` are still `float: right` (lines 306-310), so they now float to the edge of the content-sized box, right beside the description text, rather than to the edge of the post column. Add `flex: 1 1 auto` (and `min-width: 0`) to `.small-action-desc`. The `float: left` on `.topic-avatar` (line 270) is also inert now, because floats are ignored on flex items, and should be removed.

findings.title: Mobile override still compensates for the removed 4em left padding
findings.description: The diff changes `.small-action-desc` padding from `0.5em 0 0.5em 4em` to `0 1.5%`, but mobile still has `.custom-message { margin-left: -40px; }`. That negative margin existed to pull the message back under the old 4em indent. With the indent gone and the avatar now a sibling flex item, it drags the custom message 40px left into the icon column, which will overlap the icon. The mobile stylesheet was not updated in this change. The adjacent `p { padding-top: 0; }` (lines 517-519) is also dead, because the `padding-top: 4px` it reset was removed from the common file.

findings.title: Header flex items have no flex sizing, so a long topic title can squeeze the icon panel
findings.description: `.title`, `.extra-info-wrapper` and `.panel` all keep the default `flex: 0 1 auto`. `.extra-info-wrapper` contains a `white-space: nowrap` topic link (`desktop/topic-post.scss:532-538`), so its base size is the full unwrapped title width. When that overflows, the shortfall is shared across all three items, not just the title. `.panel` contains only floated children (`.icons`, login buttons at lines 42-61), so its minimum width is roughly one icon. It can therefore be shrunk until the icons wrap onto several lines inside the 60px header. Pin the fixed items with `flex: 0 0 auto` on `.panel` and `.title`, and give `.extra-info-wrapper` `flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0`.

findings.title: Flexbox mixins emit invalid or mismatched legacy properties
findings.description:
The mixins work for the values passed today (`center`, `baseline`, `2`, `3`) but are wrong in general:
- **`order($val)` (lines 125-131):** it passes the same value to `-webkit-box-ordinal-group` / `-moz-box-ordinal-group`. Those are 1-based with a default of 1, while `order` is 0-based. `order(0)` emits an invalid value and `order(1)` sorts differently in old and modern engines; the legacy lines need `$val + 1`.
- **`align-items($alignment)` (lines 117-123):** `-webkit-box-align` and `-ms-flex-align` take `start`/`end`, not `flex-start`/`flex-end`, so those values would be silently dropped on the legacy paths.
- **`-ms-align-items` (line 121):** this is not a real property; IE10 uses `-ms-flex-align` and IE11 the unprefixed form.
- **Missing `-moz-box-align`:** `flexbox()` emits `display: -moz-box` (line 102) but there is no matching alignment property, so the old-Firefox path is half-supported.

findings.title: Mixin formatting and prefix ordering are inconsistent with the rest of the file
findings.description: `align-items` uses 4-space indentation where its sibling mixins use 2, has trailing whitespace on line 120, and is missing a space in `align-items:$alignment` on line 122. `inline-flex()` orders its prefixes differently from `flexbox()`: `-webkit-inline-flex` comes before the `-moz`/`-ms` fallbacks, whereas `flexbox()` puts `-webkit-flex` after them. Both resolve correctly, but the two should follow one pattern.

findings.title: `.contents` keeps its `clearfix` class while becoming a flex container
findings.description: `templates/header.hbs:2` renders `<div class='contents clearfix'>`, and `.clearfix` (`common/foundation/helpers.scss:53-62`) generates `::before`/`::after` with `display: table`. In a flex container these become zero-width flex items. They are harmless with the current `margin-left: auto` layout, but they would create phantom gaps if `justify-content: space-between` or `flex-wrap` were added later. With the floats gone the clearfix is no longer needed on `.contents`. Separately, the header ordering rule for `.extra-info-wrapper` sits in `common/base/topic.scss:30`, away from the `.panel` order in `header.scss` that it depends on.

findings.title: Header ordering and badge mixin substitution are correct
findings.description: DOM order in `templates/header.hbs` is `.title` (from `components/home-logo.js.es6:2`), then `.panel` (line 6), then `.extra-info-wrapper` (line 94). `order(2)` on the wrapper and `order(3)` on the panel, with `.title` at the default, gives the intended logo → topic info → icons sequence, and `margin-left: auto` correctly replaces `float: right`. In `badges.css.scss`, swapping the raw `display: inline-flex; align-items: baseline` for the mixins is behaviour-preserving in modern browsers.
